overview: The United Arab Emirates is a federation of seven emirates on the Arabian Peninsula, including Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Its capital is Abu Dhabi, and its largest city is Dubai, home to the Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world. The country was formed in the early 1970s. Oil made it rich, and today trade, tourism and finance are also important.

geography.text: Most of the UAE is sandy desert, with high dunes in the south towards the Empty Quarter. The Hajar Mountains rise in the north-east, along the border with Oman. Its long coast on the Persian Gulf has many islands, and some, such as the Palm Islands off Dubai, were built on reclaimed land.

history.text: The Gulf coast was home to trading and pearling communities for centuries. In the 1800s the local sheikhdoms signed treaties with Britain and became known as the Trucial States. In 1971 six of them formed the United Arab Emirates, and Ras Al Khaimah joined in 1972. Oil wealth, exported from 1962, transformed the country.

events.title: Treaty with Britain
events.text: The sheikhdoms sign the first of several treaties with Britain.

events.title: First oil exports
events.text: Abu Dhabi exports its first oil.

events.title: Seventh emirate
events.text: Ras Al Khaimah joins the federation.

events.title: Burj Khalifa
events.text: The world's tallest building opens in Dubai.

government.text: The United Arab Emirates is a federation of seven emirates, each ruled by its own monarch. The rulers form the Federal Supreme Council, which elects the President, traditionally the ruler of Abu Dhabi, while the ruler of Dubai is Prime Minister. Half of the advisory Federal National Council is elected by a limited group of citizens.

economy.text: Oil, mostly in Abu Dhabi, made the UAE rich, and Dubai has built a global hub for trade, finance, tourism and air travel. Emirates and Etihad airlines link the world through its airports. Most residents are foreign workers.

culture.text: The UAE combines Bedouin traditions, such as falconry and Arabic poetry, with ultra-modern cities. Dubai's Burj Khalifa is the tallest building in the world. The Louvre Abu Dhabi opened in 2017.

items.title: Louvre Abu Dhabi
items.text: An art museum under a giant lattice dome.

items.title: Hope probe
items.text: The UAE's spacecraft reached Mars orbit in 2021.

sport.text: The Abu Dhabi Grand Prix often closes the Formula 1 season, and the Dubai World Cup is one of the richest horse races. Cricket is very popular, and the UAE has hosted many international matches.

items.title: Yas Marina
items.text: Hosts the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.

items.title: Dubai World Cup
items.text: One of the world's richest horse races.

didYouKnow: Dubai's Burj Khalifa is the tallest building in the world, at 828 metres.
The UAE sent a probe to Mars, which reached orbit in 2021.
